author: KojaCola
body:
Recently, I was looking through the stats section on the forums and stumbled upon the K/D section. I noticed that most of the players had been banned. The stats should only be for non- banned players. Having the current K/D stats defeats the whole purpose. Making the K/D section (as well as other sections) should be for non-banned players only.

-Koja.
